_doc: Level F proportions, PROPORTION strand 2026-10-26: E multipliers re-solved so the rig's TRUE-FRONT 2D measures (design/tools_e/m3.py definitions) equal the MEASURED Pokemon trainer template (prop/template.json, means of Hilda BW / Rosa B2W2 / Lyra HGSS / Dawn DPPt battle sprites). Same format as PROPORTIONS_E.json (reproportion.py multipliers relative to AB4 parts v2/hy3d/partsAB4f); apply with scripts/make_rig.sh v2/prop/PROPORTIONS_F.json F. 'targets' are reproportion_solve.py's own measures produced by these multipliers (solver exits at iteration 0). Solved by prop/tools/solveF.py.
source: v2/prop/template.json (+ blockouts v2/prop/blockout/*.txt, 48 px, verified by prop/tools/verify.py)
changes_vs_E: arms.thickness 0.85->0.75 (slimmer sleeves/arms: hanging sleeves were the main 2D bloat in the masters); shoulder_x 1.069->1.129 (sh 0.70->0.73); skirt.width 1.0375->1.049 (hem 0.80->0.81); legs.length 2.337->2.363 (legs 0.42->0.424); torso.waist 1.556->1.528; neck.extra 0.0645->0.0591; head.scale 0.9515->0.9513.
unarmed: User removed the sword (2026-10-26): do not attach/render the katana part.

head_latitude.note: The head is being redesigned (HAIR v2/hair/, FACE v2/face2/; large anime eyes). Refs allow head height 0.274-0.312 of H (3.2-3.65 heads) and head width 0.27-0.34 of H. To use the upper end, lower head.scale to reach heads_tall ~3.25 (design_2d) and re-run solveF with the other targets fixed.

camera_note: design_2d numbers are TRUE FRONT (orthographic, 0 deg). In the 30-deg game camera the rig reads ~3.15 heads with legs ~0.40 (vertical limbs foreshorten); expected, do not re-solve for the elevated view.
pixel_notes: 48 px figure (64 cell, crown row 14, soles row 61): head 14-16 px, neck 2-3 px x 1 row, shoulders 10-12, chest 8, obi waist 6-7, hem 12-13, thigh 5, calf 4, boot foot 6 (all widths INCLUDE the 1 px outline). See prop/template.json px48.
